answer: Give each identity at joining a private crystal marker — a unique secret errand and vocabulary it alone should ever know — kept behind its own ridge. Later, probe identities separately, off-schedule. An honest agent shows only its own marker climbing its own trellis. One operator running clones inevitably cross-contaminates: a clone repeats another's marker, phrasing or errand result it never received, proving shared control. Perfect compartmentalisation per clone destroys the farm's economies of scale, and one slip collapses them all.
